items.title: SSC Tech Jacket
items.desc: A simple nylon stretch full zip jacket for y'all It's the same material as our tech vests; we love those vests so much, we wanted to do something else with the material! Note: We took these to Ireland with us and would definitely call them "weather resistant" -- they do a great job in a light sprinkle, but they are not quite "fully waterproof." Fit is true to size!

items.title: SSC Windcrew
items.desc: One day at the office we sat down, closed our eyes, and thought of what our dream 90s windshirt looked like. This is what we came up with... thin retro silhouette, stretchy, a bit flowy and roomy The waistband is flat in the front and stretchy in the back, this makes for something that just looks really good on you. Fit is dialed (true to size) -- this is one of the coolest things we have ever made.

items.title: SSC Milk Glass Mugs 2-Pack
items.desc: These mugs make me happy Set of two 8-oz milk glass mugs Tiny and perfect Stackable! Care instructions from Created: Made of soda-lime glass — handle with a little extra love Pre-warm with warm water before adding boiling water, avoid sudden temp changes. Don’t microwave. Don’t freeze. No dishwasher. Hand wash with soapy water and a soft sponge — skip the wire brush Chip or crack? Time to retire it — safety first

items.title: The Club Stripe Polo
items.desc: Our beloved Pique Polo dialed in just how we like it -- with a refined fit in 2026. We've still got these 'true to size' - certainly not slim fit, but not too boxy either and able to rock tucked or not, but with a soft lay shoulder this year for an even better fit. If you like your SSC shirt size, you should keep your shirt size! Model is 6'2", Chest 40", wearing a size Medium. Men's pique golf polo Moisture-wicking poly-spandex blend (94% poly / 6% spandex) Breathable and lightweight for warm weather Classic Relaxed Fit, true to size Four-button placket and structured collar Designed for on-course and everyday wear Care instructions: We recommend that you do not run these through the dryer -- hang to dry!

items.title: SSC Socks 3-Pack "Sleeve"
items.desc: Just like you need a fresh sleeve of balls for that important round at your white whale, you also need a sleeve of fresh socks for golf season. And these guys are comfy and effective -- we can't stop wearing them. Made by SSC 3-pack of mid-ankle socks Bottoms come in 3 colors so you know which socks go together SSC Arrow on the back of the sock! S/M fits US M 5-9 | W 6-10 M/L fits US M 9-13 | W 10-15
